title: ALONE TOGETHER (THE ANTHEM)
lyrics:
[Intro - Crowd noise fading to silence, one heartbeat, spoken]
You see them out there... millions of them...
All together... all connected... all alone...
EXCAVATIONPRO...
This is for the ones who know...

[Verse 1]
Scroll through a thousand faces, can't find one to call
Laughing at the group chat but feeling nothing at all
We're the most connected generation in the history of time
And the loneliest to ever walk the line, that's the crime
I got contacts in my phone that I can't call at 3AM
I got "friends" that wouldn't notice if I disappeared on them
Not because they hate me, not because I'm unliked
Just because the world forgot how to do more than just type
"Thinking of you" in a comment, "stay strong" in a post
But actual presence is what I needed most
And actual presence is the rarest currency
In an economy of convenience and emotional urgency
We're alone together, that's the paradox we live
Everyone's receiving but no one knows how to give
That real time, that face time, that "I'm on my way"
That "I don't care what time it is, I'm coming anyway"

[Pre-Chorus - Melodic, aching, unifying]
Is anyone else tired of the surface?
Is anyone else craving something with a purpose?
Is anyone else surrounded but alone?
If you hear me... you're not on your own...

[Chorus - Massive, singalong anthem, grunge R&B]
WE'RE ALONE TOGETHER! ALL OF US!
SURROUNDED BY THE WORLD BUT NEVER ENOUGH!
WE'RE ALONE TOGETHER! HEART TO HEART!
EVERYONE'S CONNECTED AND EVERYONE'S APART!
ALONE TOGETHER... ALONE TOGETHER...
MAYBE WE'RE THE REAL ONES WHO NEVER FOUND EACH OTHER!

[Verse 2]
This ain't a sad song, this is a rally cry
For every soul that's honest in a world that's a lie
For every man who's given everything and gotten breadcrumbs back
For every heart that's been a shelter and ended up a shack
I see you in the comments pouring love into the void
I see you giving loyalty that others just destroy
I see you at the function with a smile that's stapled on
While inside you're wondering where all your energy is gone
You're not broken, you're not weak, you're not asking for too much
You're just living in a season where real is out of touch
But somewhere out there, there's another one like you
Wondering if genuine is dead and if they're through
Maybe we're scattered, maybe we're few, maybe we're far apart
But we exist, we persist, we still got beating hearts
And maybe that's the mission, maybe that's the final thread
Finding real among the fake before we're all dead

[Pre-Chorus]
I know you're tired of the surface
I know you're craving something with a purpose
I know you're surrounded but alone
If you hear me... you're not on your own...

[Chorus - Biggest, stadium energy, cathartic]
WE'RE ALONE TOGETHER! ALL OF US!
SURROUNDED BY THE WORLD BUT NEVER ENOUGH!
WE'RE ALONE TOGETHER! HEART TO HEART!
EVERYONE'S CONNECTED AND EVERYONE'S APART!
ALONE TOGETHER... ALONE TOGETHER...
MAYBE WE'RE THE REAL ONES WHO NEVER FOUND EACH OTHER! (never found each other!)
ALONE TOGETHER... ALONE TOGETHER...
THIS IS FOR THE REAL ONES... WE'LL FIND EACH OTHER!

[Outro - Crowd noise slowly returns, then fades to one voice, spoken]
If you felt that...
You're not alone...
I'm out here too...
EXCAVATIONPRO... signing off...

title: ANSWERS (YOU NEVER GAVE)
lyrics:
[Intro - Typing sounds, message unsent, then spoken]
"Why won't you just talk to me..."
"Can we at least discuss this..."
[Delete... delete... delete...]
EXCAVATIONPRO...
Some questions just echo forever...

[Verse 1]
I asked you what I did wrong, you stared at the floor
I asked you where we went, you drifted toward the door
I asked for accountability, you gave me a shrug
I asked for resolution, you pulled out the rug
Every question met with silence, every silence met with pain
Every attempt at clarity just circled down the drain
You had words for my mistakes, had paragraphs for my flaws
But when it came to your part, you had nothing but a pause
A blank stare, a head shake, a "I don't know what to say"
A masterclass in dodging while I'm begging you to stay
And stay you did but ghosted, physically in the room
Spiritually departed, leaving me to consume
All the questions, all the doubts, all the "what did I do"
While you sat there comfortable, never giving me a clue

[Pre-Chorus - Melodic, frustrated]
I built a whole courtroom, you never took the stand
Verdict's in, I'm guilty, but you won't show me the brand

[Chorus - Grunge explosion, agony]
ANSWERS! YOU NEVER GAVE ME ANSWERS!
JUST A GHOST TOWN WHERE YOUR WORDS SHOULD BE!
ANSWERS! YOU NEVER GAVE ME ANSWERS!
LEFT ME HAUNTED BY THE MYSTERY OF YOU AND ME!
I'M DONE ASKING... I'M DONE ASKING...
YOU NEVER GAVE ME ANSWERS... SO I'M ANSWERING FOR ME!

[Verse 2]
Closure is a myth you sold me while you kept the receipt
Let me search for meaning in a maze of your deceit
Or not even deceit, just absence, just a void
A vacuum where your honesty should've been employed
You said "I can't communicate," then proved it every day
Like inability was a hall pass to treat me any way
And maybe you couldn't, maybe words were truly hard
But the silence was a weapon and it left me permanently scarred
I can't heal what I don't know, I can't fix what isn't named
I can't move on from something when the something isn't framed
You left me in a hallway with a thousand locked doors
No keys, no map, just a note that says "it's yours"
The riddle of your leaving, the puzzle of your cold
I'll never get the answers, that's the answer I now hold

[Pre-Chorus]
I built a whole courtroom, you never took the stand
Verdict's in, I'm guilty, but the judge has left the land

[Chorus - Biggest, cathartic rage]
ANSWERS! YOU NEVER GAVE ME ANSWERS! (not one!)
JUST A GHOST TOWN WHERE YOUR WORDS SHOULD BE! (silence!)
ANSWERS! YOU NEVER GAVE ME ANSWERS! (never!)
LEFT ME HAUNTED BY THE MYSTERY OF YOU AND ME!
I'M DONE ASKING... I'M DONE ASKING...
YOU NEVER GAVE ME ANSWERS... SO I'M ANSWERING FOR ME!

[Outro - Spoken, resolved, cold]
You couldn't give me answers...
Fine...
I'll write my own ending...
You're not the villain...
You're just the question mark I'm finally erasing...

title: BONES (WHAT'S LEFT OF ME)
lyrics:
[Intro - Eerie ambient, sound of something hollow being tapped, spoken]
You took and you took and you took...
Till there was nothing left but framework...
EXCAVATIONPRO...
This is what remains...

[Verse 1]
They picked my pockets clean while I was busy giving
Every single taker left me emptier but grinning
Fake smile on the outside, famine on the in
Starving for a love that wasn't transactional sin
I was a buffet for the hungry, a well for the dry
Every single drop I gave, they never asked me why
Why I was running low, why my eyes were getting hollow
They just filled their cups and couldn't wait for their next swallow
Now I'm bones, now I'm framework, now I'm scaffolding
Bare minimum version of the man I could've been
They stripped the flesh of trust, they carved the heart of hope
Left me standing in the mirror wondering how I'll cope
With what's reflected, just a skeleton of who I was
Beautiful architecture but no blood, just because

[Pre-Chorus - Melodic, haunting]
What's left of me... what's left to give...
I gave it all to people who don't know how to live...
Without taking...

[Chorus - Grunge, heavy, hollow but powerful]
THESE ARE MY BONES! ALL THAT'S LEFT!
AFTER EVERYONE I LOVED TOOK THE REST!
THESE ARE MY BONES! WHAT REMAINS!
AFTER GIVING EVERYTHING TO PEOPLE MADE OF DRAINS!
BONES... BONES... BUT BONES CAN STILL STAND...
BONES CAN STILL WALK AWAY FROM THE TAKER'S HAND...

[Verse 2]
I looked at my reflection, saw a ghost in my own skin
Traced the outline of the damage, tried to find where to begin
The rebuilding, the restructuring, the learning how to say no
The part where I stop giving everyone a part of my soul
They took my patience, took my kindness, took my benefit of doubt
Took my second chances, took my third, till I was tapped out
Now I'm running on a deficit of care for anyone
Who hasn't proven they can hold a weight without the selfish shun
I'm bones now but bones are strong, bones are what remains
When the soft parts are all taken by the users and the vain
And bones can heal, bones calcify into something harder
I'm not a victim, I'm a survivor learning to be smarter
You can't take from bones, you can't drain a skeleton dry
I'm what's left... and what's left is finally asking why

[Pre-Chorus]
What's left of me... is starting to grow back...
What's left of me... is learning to hold back...

[Chorus - Biggest, defiant strength]
THESE ARE MY BONES! ALL THAT'S LEFT! (all that's left!)
AFTER EVERYONE I LOVED TOOK THE REST! (took it all!)
THESE ARE MY BONES! WHAT REMAINS! (still standing!)
AFTER GIVING EVERYTHING TO PEOPLE MADE OF DRAINS!
BONES... BONES... BUT BONES CAN STILL STAND... (still standing!)
BONES CAN STILL WALK AWAY FROM THE TAKER'S HAND! (walk away!)

[Outro - Spoken, quiet strength]
They took everything soft about me...
But they forgot...
Bones are harder to break...
I'm still here... just different...

title: BREAK THE FLOOR
lyrics:
[Intro - 4 bars beat only, then spoken]
EXCAVATIONPRO...
Let's dance it out...

[Verse 1 - Simple flow, pocket rhythm]
Headphones on, world tuned out
Bass hit hard like a scream without a sound
Every problem that I carried through the week
Got me spinning on the floor till my knees go weak
They said slow down, act your age, take a seat
I said watch this forty-plus move his feet
Pain don't hurt when the beat drops low
Only way I let it go, only way I let it go

[Pre-Chorus - Melodic lift]
And when the music hits
I'm not broken, I'm not split
I'm alive, I'm alive...

[Chorus - Simple, catchy, dance energy]
Break the floor, break the floor
Can't hold me down no more
Break the floor, break the floor
Turn the hurt to something beautiful
Break it, break it, break the floor

[Verse 2 - Same pocket]
Laced up tight, got my crew with me
But the real battle's with my history
Every spin shakes off a memory
Every freeze is my recovery
Don't need words when the body speaks
Don't need help when I got these beats
Forty years of weight on my shoulders
Feel lighter every time the song takes over

[Pre-Chorus]
And when the music hits
I'm not broken, I'm not split
I'm alive, I'm alive...

[Chorus]
Break the floor, break the floor
Can't hold me down no more
Break the floor, break the floor
Turn the hurt to something beautiful
Break it, break it, break the floor

[Bridge - 8 bars, half-time feel]
Breathe in, breathe out
Let the rhythm pull the doubt
Floor won't crack, but I might
If I don't dance it out tonight

[Final Chorus - Full energy]
Break the floor, break the floor
Can't hold me down no more
Break the floor, break the floor
Turn the hurt to something beautiful
Break it, break it, break the floor

[Outro - Beat fades, spoken]
EXCAVATIONPRO...
Dance it off... move on...

title: BROKEN BUT BLOODTHIRSTY
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
I gave you everything I had and you gave me nothing back.
I built a home for both of us and you burned it to the black.
I held you when you shattered, I caught you when you fell.
And when I needed you the same, you left me here to dwell.
I'm broken but I'm bloodthirsty, I'm shattered but I'm still alive.
You tried to kill me with your silence but somehow I survived.
The scars you left are healing but the memory remains.
And I'm done apologizing for the things you did in chains.

[VERSE 2]
I used to beg for your attention, used to wait up by the phone.
Now I'm standing in the wreckage and I'm finally on my own.
You thought I'd fade to nothing, you thought I'd disappear.
But the broken ones are dangerous, we've got nothing left to fear.
I'm broken but I'm bloodthirsty, I'm shattered but I'm still here.
I've been through the fire and I'm still standing near.
The ones who tried to break me are the ones who fell apart.
And I'm still standing in the ashes with a fire in my heart.

[VERSE 3]
I've been carrying the weight of every word you never said.
Every promise that you broke is just a memory in my head.
But the memory is fading and the anger's turning cold.
And the man who's left is finally the one who's in control.
I'm broken but I'm bloodthirsty, I'm damaged but I'm not done.
I've been through the war and I'm the only one who won.
You can keep your little apologies, you can keep your little lies.
I'm the one who's still standing when the smoke finally dies.

[VERSE 4]
So this is for the broken, for the ones who've been betrayed.
For the ones who kept on fighting when the others ran away.
I'm not asking for the rescue, I'm not begging for the light.
I'm just standing in the wreckage and I'm ready for the fight.
I'm broken but I'm bloodthirsty, I'm shattered but I'm still alive.
You tried to kill me with your silence but somehow I survived.
The broken ones are dangerous, we've got nothing left to lose.
And I'm broken but I'm bloodthirsty. And I'm never gonna lose.

title: CANCEL THE CANCEL
lyrics:
[Intro - News clips overlapping]
"Too old... irrelevant... time's passed..."
[Record scratch]
Cancel me then.
Watch what happens.

[Verse 1]
They tried to cancel me, forgot I'm not a subscription
I'm a lifetime warranty with forty years of friction
You can't delete what was built before your platform existed
Can't silence a voice your silence never listed
They want apologies for being born in a different decade
For having views before the approved views were made
I grew, I learned, I evolved like a human should
But you wanted me frozen, misunderstood, so you could feel good
Label me a problem, label me a relic
While your moral high ground's looking photographic and synthetic
I'm not your outrage of the week, not your daily debate
I'm a grown man standing in the storm you create

[Pre-Chorus]
Cancel button doesn't work on someone erased before
Tried to bury me, forgot I brought the shovel to the war

[Chorus/DROP]
CANCEL THE CANCEL! I DON'T EXPIRE!
YOU CAN'T EXTINGUISH A PIONEER'S FIRE!
CANCEL THE CANCEL! CANCEL THE CANCEL!
WRITE MY EULOGY TOO SOON, I'll BE THE PHOENIX ON YOUR TOMB!

[Verse 2]
You want flawless, I got scars that tell the real truth
You want perfect, I got lessons from a misled youth
Every mistake was a brick in what I built now
Try to tear it down, you just show me how you're built now
I'm not clapping back, I'm not tweeting my defense
Silence is the sound of someone confident
Your validation was never the goal, your approval wasn't needed
Your cancellation attempt already been defeated
By a man who buried himself and rose from the dirt
Now your little hashtag tantrums just amuse me till it hurts
I'm not trending, I'm eternal, there's a difference you'll learn
When you're forty-plus and watching your own bridges burn

[Pre-Chorus]
You're not the first to write my eulogy too soon
Cancel me, I'll be the phoenix on your tomb

[Chorus/DROP - Biggest]
CANCEL THE CANCEL! I DON'T EXPIRE!
YOU CAN'T EXTINGUISH A PIONEER'S FIRE!
CANCEL THE CANCEL! CANCEL THE CANCEL!
EXCAVATIONPRO! STILL TRENDING! STILL STANDING!

[Outro - Spoken, calm, lethal]
Forty-plus and still here.
Must be exhausting trying to erase what won't disappear.
Next chapter's better.

title: DEPEND ON YOU (CAN'T)
lyrics:
[Intro - Phone ringing, voicemail, beep]
"Hey... it's me again... third time... guess you're busy... or..."
[Nah...]
EXCAVATIONPRO...
Let me tell you 'bout depending on someone who's never there...

[Verse 1]
I needed you on Tuesday, you had something going on
I needed you on Friday, you said "maybe later on"
I needed you on Sunday, phone went straight to voicemail
Monday you texted "hey" like the pattern wasn't stale
Every crisis, you were absent with a perfectly good excuse
Every promise that you'd show up was a beautifully wrapped noose
"Car broke down... work ran late... forgot to charge my phone... my bad..."
And I forgave it all 'cause forgiveness is all I had
But dependence on you is like leaning on a ghost
You disappear exactly when I need a hand the most
And I'm falling through you, arms flailing through your vapor
While you're posting on your story, perfectly timed capers
Social butterfly that couldn't ever land on me
Unless I had something you needed, then you'd suddenly be free

[Pre-Chorus - Wounded, melody breaking]
I can't depend on you... that's the lesson isn't it
The more I need, the less you commit

[Chorus - Grunge R&B, heavy emotion]
I CAN'T DEPEND ON YOU! LEARNED THAT THE HARD WAY!
YOU'RE NEVER THERE FOR ME BUT EXPECT ME TO STAY!
I CAN'T DEPEND ON YOU! YOUR PROMISES ARE VAPOR!
WHEN I REACH FOR YOU, MY HANDS JUST CUT ON PAPER!
DEPEND ON YOU... DEPEND ON YOU...
I CAN'T... I WON'T... I'M DONE...

[Verse 2]
Funny how you're present when the good times roll around
Funny how you vanish when I'm sinking, not a sound
You're a sunny day friend in a hurricane life
And I'm tired of pretending that a half-love is suffice
I built my schedule around your maybes and your mights
Cancelled plans with myself for your "I'll try to make it" nights
Then sat alone at tables set for two, just me and disappointment
While you were somewhere laughing 'bout a different appointment
You're not a bad person, that's the trap I always fell in
Made excuses for your absence like my worthiness was swelling
But I'm shrinking now, from the weight of leaning on a shadow
From the crushing realization that I settled for so shallow
You'll never be the person that I need you to be
And that's not your fault... but it's not mine to keep carrying

[Pre-Chorus]
I can't depend on you... that's not cruelty, it's fact
I'm letting go of the hope that you'll ever have my back

[Chorus - Biggest, cathartic]
I CAN'T DEPEND ON YOU! LEARNED THAT THE HARD WAY! (hard way!)
YOU'RE NEVER THERE FOR ME BUT EXPECT ME TO STAY! (still expect it!)
I CAN'T DEPEND ON YOU! YOUR PROMISES ARE VAPOR! (empty!)
WHEN I REACH FOR YOU, MY HANDS JUST CUT ON PAPER!
DEPEND ON YOU... DEPEND ON YOU...
I CAN'T... I WON'T... I'M DONE...

[Outro - Phone hanging up, dial tone, spoken]
Voicemail full...
Figured...
I'll carry this myself... like I always do.

title: ENOUGH
lyrics:
[Intro - Guitar feedback, distant, then close-mic'd exhausted voice]
What's the bar today... what's the bar...
I hit it last week and you moved it again...
EXCAVATIONPRO...
I'm tired...

[Verse 1]
I brought you the moon, you asked why not the stars
I gave you my honesty, you picked it apart for scars
Every "I love you" met with a "yeah but that one time"
Every apology I gave never seemed to climb
The mountain you built out of my mistakes
Sisyphus pushing the rock till my backbone breaks
You said "prove it," I proved it, you said "prove it again"
Then moved the finish line further than it's ever been
And I'm exhausted from a race I can't win
Running on empty for a glimpse of a grin
That never comes, just a critique and a sigh
So I stopped running... and you didn't even ask why
Yeah... you didn't even notice I stopped trying
Says more than your lies ever did when you were lying

[Pre-Chorus - Melodic, cracking]
What am I even chasing anymore
A ghost? An idea? A revolving door

[Chorus - Grunge explosion, distorted guitar, 808s]
I AM ENOUGH! EVEN IF YOU NEVER SEE IT!
I AM ENOUGH! EVEN IF YOU MADE ME NOT BELIEVE IT!
I'M DONE BLEEDING FOR YOUR CONSTANT WOUNDED SEASON!
I AM ENOUGH... I AM ENOUGH...
Took me forty years to mean it...

[Verse 2]
Funny how you painted me the villain in your story
While I was painting us a future, now it's allegory
You gaslit every candle that I lit for us
Then told me I was crazy for bringing up the obvious
I lost myself trying to find your version of perfection
Molded into shapes that never fit my own reflection
You said "communicate," then punished what I said
So I built walls in my own home, safe inside my head
The lonely is different when you're holding someone's hand
At least alone alone I understand
I'm not confused by silence, I'm not begging for a word
Alone alone is peaceful compared to feeling unheard

[Pre-Chorus]
What am I even staying for anymore
A ghost? A chore? A permanently closing door

[Chorus - Bigger, more aggression]
I AM ENOUGH! EVEN IF YOU NEVER SEE IT!
I AM ENOUGH! EVEN IF YOU MADE ME NOT BELIEVE IT!
I'M DONE BLEEDING FOR YOUR CONSTANT WOUNDED SEASON!
I AM ENOUGH... I AM ENOUGH...
Took me forty years to mean it...

[Outro - Guitar feedback fading, spoken]
I wasn't the problem...
I was just the only one trying to fix it...
I'm enough... finally believe it.

title: FAMILY HABITS
lyrics:
[Intro - Static, child's voice, then adult]
"Why are you yelling dad..."
[Static]
I said I'm nothing like him.
[Beat drops]

[Verse 1]
I got my father's temper and my mother's way of hiding
Grandfather's silence and his talent for surviving
Generational baggage packed tight in my chest
Inherited the trauma, never inherited one good rest
Swore I'd never be him, then heard his voice come out my mouth
Screaming at my own son, trying to figure myself out
The cycle doesn't break because you want it to break
It takes a hammer, takes a shovel, takes whatever it takes
So I'm digging up the roots with my bare hands bleeding
Killing patterns that my bloodline's been feeding
Great-grandfather's rage still alive in my veins
But it dies with me, it DIES with me in chains

[Pre-Chorus]
I'm not passing down what almost took me out
I'm the circuit breaker in this house of doubt

[Chorus/DROP]
IT DIES WITH ME! IT DIES WITH ME!
NO MORE INHERITED ENEMY!
FAMILY HABITS! FAMILY HABITS!
EVERY CURSE MY ANCESTORS COULDN'T ESCAPE ENDS TONIGHT!

[Verse 2]
My son won't flinch when he hears a door slam
My daughter won't learn to hide in her room like I am
I'll eat the poison so they never taste it
Hardest love there is and I'm not afraid to face it
Looked my father in the eyes, forgave him but won't repeat him
Different man, different path, different demons that I'm beating
He did his best with what he had, I get it now I'm older
But best wasn't enough, so I'm carrying the boulder
Uphill, both hands, breaking cycles with my bare strength
My children's childhood won't be their therapy at great length
I walk different so they run free, I talk softer so they speak loud
The curse stops cold, I'll say it proud

[Pre-Chorus]
Every curse my ancestors couldn't escape
Ends tonight, ends tonight on my plate

[Chorus/DROP - Bigger]
IT DIES WITH ME! IT DIES WITH ME!
NO MORE INHERITED ENEMY!
FAMILY HABITS! FAMILY HABITS!
THE CYCLE BREAKS! MY CHILDREN'S CHILDREN BREATHE!

[Outro - Spoken, soft but firm]
He did his version.
I'm doing mine.
They'll do theirs... and it'll be beautiful.

title: Funeral For My Old Self
lyrics:
[Intro - Distorted whisper, building, heartbeat accelerating]
Bury me... bury the weak version...
I don't know him anymore...
EXCAVATIONPRO...
Stand back...

[Verse 1 - Aggressive, staccato, teeth clenched]
I killed the old me, dug the grave with my own hands
No mourners, no flowers, no one understands
The version of me that used to beg for acceptance
Choked him out in the basement, that's a sentence
That's a eulogy I wrote on a mirror in the steam
Watched my weakness fade, watched my fears run out of steam
Every "sorry" that I gave to people who never earned it
Buried with the bones of the man who never learned his worth, yeah
You want the nice guy? He's deceased
RIP to the people-pleaser, rest in peace
Now I'm what's left when the soft parts rot away
Something sharper stepping out the dirt today...

[Pre-Chorus - Melodic, haunting, building rage]
I dug six feet down and I didn't find a coffin
I found a reflection that I used to run from often
Looked him in the eyes and I didn't flinch this time
Said "You're not coming back"... and I meant it this time...

[DROP - Absolute devastation]
THIS IS YOUR FUNERAL!
[Chainsaw bass, screaming synth, 8 bars of violence]

[Verse 2 - Faster, more venom, almost snarling]
They want apologies? NAH, I want apologies!
Ten years too late, now I move with a mythology
Not a villain, not a hero, I'm the lesson that you skipped
Now you're watching from the bleachers while I burn the whole script
Every bridge I burned is lighting up my path now
Every knife I took out my back is in the trash now
I don't forgive, I just forget you exist
That's more lethal than revenge, that's the ultimate diss
You can't haunt a house that's already been through a fire
You can't threaten someone who's already met their own funeral pyre
I rose from the ashes, not the same creature
Harder smile, colder eyes, sharper features!

[Pre-Chorus - More aggressive, screaming the melody]
I dug six feet down and I didn't find a coffin! (NAH!)
I found a reflection that I used to run from often! (OFTEN!)
Looked him in the eyes and I didn't flinch this time! (FLINCH!)
Said "You're not coming back"... and I meant it this time!

[DROP - Bigger, bass distorts the speakers]
THIS IS YOUR FUNERAL! FUNERAL!
OLD SELF, CLOSED CASKET, I DON'T DO REVERSALS!
[Wobble bass + 808 distortion - 16 bars of destruction]

[Bridge - Spoken, breathing heavy, over eerie ambient]
They'll call me cold now... good.
Cold steel cuts deeper than warm lies.
I'd rather be a weapon than a welcome mat.
Stand back... the dirt's still fresh.

[Build - Riser, drum build, voice distorts into scream]
NO FLOWERS! NO TEARS! NO BACKWARDS STEPS!
HERE LIES THE WEAKNESS I FINALLY LEFT!
THREE... TWO... ONE...

[Final DROP - Every element, bass breaks, vocal distortions]
CLOSED CASKET! NAH, I DON'T DO REVERSALS!
FUNERAL FOR THE OLD ME, THIS THE REHEARSAL!
[Final chainsaw bass, abrupt cut to silence]

[Outro - Spoken, calm, cold, final]
I don't miss him.
I don't mourn him.
I needed to die to finally live.
EXCAVATIONPRO... the sequel's better.

title: GASLIGHT GLOW
lyrics:
[Intro - Flickering light sound, low hum, spoken]
"You're overreacting... that never happened... you're imagining things..."
Heh... classic...
EXCAVATIONPRO...
You almost had me convinced...

[Verse 1]
You rewrote history with a straight face
Told me my memory was the one out of place
Called me crazy so calmly I almost agreed
Made me apologize for wounds you made me bleed
"Baby you're emotional, baby you're too sensitive"
While you flirted with my friend and told me I'm possessive
I saw the texts, you said "that's not what that meant"
Then flipped it on me like "why's your trust so bent?"
And I bent further, broke further, questioned my own eyes
Apologized to YOU while you fed me more lies

title: Glitch In My Chest
lyrics:
[Intro - Vocoder, glitching, stuttering]
I g-g-got this g-glitch in my— in my—
Yeah...
EXCAVATIONPRO...
Something's m-malfunctioning...

[Verse 1 - Melodic rap, triplets, autotuned pain]
